definitions.explanation: An organization or facility dedicated to scientific or academic research.

examples.japanese: {国立|こくりつ}{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a national research institute.

examples.japanese: この{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}では{新薬|しんやく}の{開発|かいはつ}をしている。
examples.english: This research institute is developing new medicines.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}が{最新|さいしん}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}について{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The university's research institute made an announcement about the latest technology.

notes:
{研究所|けんきゅうじょ} is a compound of {研究|けんきゅう} (research) + {所|じょ} (place, facility). It refers to an institution dedicated to research.

PRONUNCIATION:
An alternate reading けんきゅうしょ also exists and is used in some proper names. The じょ reading is more common in general usage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {国立|こくりつ}{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}: national research institute
- {大学|だいがく}{附属|ふぞく}{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}: university-affiliated research institute
- {研究所|けんきゅうじょ}で{働|はたら}く: to work at a research institute
- {研究所|けんきゅうじょ}{長|ちょう}: director of a research institute

WELL-KNOWN EXAMPLES:
- {理化学研究所|りかがくけんきゅうじょ} (RIKEN): Japan's largest scientific research institution
- {産業技術総合研究所|さんぎょうぎじゅつそうごうけんきゅうじょ} (AIST)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {研究所|けんきゅうじょ}: research institute (independent facility)
- {研究室|けんきゅうしつ}: research lab/office (within a university)

cross_references.description: Alternate reading けんきゅうしょ
